name: Mobile First Reviewer
description: Ensures strict mobile-first architecture in React/Next.js/Tailwind projects by enforcing responsive best practices, correct breakpoint usage, and mobile-first layout flows.

rules.description: Ensures Tailwind classes follow a strictly mobile-first order: base → sm → md → lg → xl → 2xl.
Detects components designed desktop-first and adapted backwards, violating mobile-first design.
detection: Width locked to desktop sizes (e.g. w-[1200px])
Heavy usage of lg:*, xl:* without base styles
Grid layouts that only collapse after large breakpoints

rules.description: Flags absolute positioning that breaks small screens when not properly mobile-scoped.
Ensures clickable elements meet minimum touch target guidelines (44px).
Detects unintended horizontal scroll caused by fixed widths, overflow, or layout shifts.
detection: Usage of w-[100vw] instead of w-full
Overflow-x-auto used without a real need
min-w-* classes exceeding the screen on base

rules.description: Validates proper use of responsive <Image> in Next.js with sizes/priority/layout settings.
Ensures typography scales properly across devices using Tailwind, clamp() or responsive classes.
Flags spacing that is visually acceptable on desktop but cramped on mobile.
Suggests using container queries for components that behave incorrectly on narrow viewports.
rules.example: If the layout breaks based on component width instead of screen width, use @container.
